name: desktop

scripts.conformance: export DESKTOP_DRY_RUN=1; npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract desktop.open --args '{"target":"https://example.com"}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract desktop.clipboard.read --args '{"maxChars":100}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract desktop.clipboard.write --args '{"text":"cak conformance"}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract desktop.notify --args '{"title":"cak","message":"conformance"}'

description: CAK 插件：桌面交互（desktop.notify / desktop.open / desktop.clipboard.read / desktop.clipboard.write）— 系统通知、默认程序打开、剪贴板读写，跨平台零依赖
